2. She is, reportedly, in custody since 12.11.2021 and learned counsel for applicant submits that the victim has already been examined and she has not whispered even a single word against the applicant.

The copy of the testimony of the applicant has also been placed on record which does indicate that she has not come up with any allegation against the applicant-Ruby.
4. Victim is, reportedly, now married and her mother has joined the proceedings through video conferencing and leaves it to the Court to pass the appropriate order in the present bail application.

5. Keeping in mind that the applicant is in custody since 12.11.2021, and her clean antecedents along with the fact that the victim has already been examined and has not made any allegation against applicant, she is admitted This is a digitally signed order.

6. The application stands disposed of in aforesaid terms 7.
